specialization_criteria.insufficient_evidence: fewer than 8 active family-capability cells or fewer than 2 capabilities with active family comparisons
specialization_criteria.meaningful_family_capability_effect: at least 2 active interventions, at least 50% measurably worsened, and mean loss increase >=0.02 nats or mean token-accuracy degradation >=0.02
specialization_criteria.moderate: at least 2 capabilities have meaningful, margin-separated effects with at least 2 different dominant families and >=3 interventions per dominant cell
specialization_criteria.strong: at least 3 capabilities have margin-separated effects with at least 2 dominant families, >=5 interventions per dominant cell, and >=75% measurable worsening
specialization_criteria.weak: a meaningful capability-specific contrast or differential effect exists, but family diversity/sample consistency is limited

status_definitions.global_collapse: at least top-k experts are near-universal, the same request set dominates, and effective utilization is close to top-k
status_definitions.healthy: no configured imbalance or liveness threshold crossed
status_definitions.mild_imbalance: utilization Gini crosses the mild threshold or at least one expert is near-dead
status_definitions.partial_collapse: strong utilization imbalance, low entropy, or at least half the experts are near-dead
status_definitions.slot_monopoly: at least one expert appears in the configured near-universal fraction of requests while other top-k slots may still vary

active_compute.note: FLOP estimates are unavailable for heterogeneous chunk backends

definitions.actively_executed_parameters: parameters in the unique module implementations executed per routing unit; shared non-module parameters are excluded
definitions.estimated_compute_relative_to_all_module: routable module parameter ratio; heterogeneous operators make this a size proxy rather than a measured FLOP ratio
definitions.module_population_touched: fraction of module identities selected at least once; ignores module size
definitions.selected_parameter_population: unique parameters belonging to modules selected in a request; not a FLOP count
